description: Road segments, with surface type is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Melbourne Open Data. Polygons representing different types of surface information, i.e. - Carriageway, footpath, kerb, channel, median, nature strip and tramway. Field descriptions: assetno - unique council reference integer. material – description of polygon surface material. instaldate - installation date of surface. Coverage: City of Melbourne Open Data. The portal files it under the publisher City of Melbourne Open Data. Its tags are accessibility, area, cityreactivation, engineering, polygons. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
